special.temporaryControl: Restart KICK control changes sanctions.on-deny only, then restores BAN. All 13 parsed keys and final QA bytes are checked.

base.finalState: QA policy retains max-online-per-ip=2 and baseline VM ALERT/timeout4; fixture is not a deployment configuration.

policyDisclosure.limits: Full unchanged default 5-account rolling quota/20 attempts rate limit is not claimed by these batch TCP runs. Only special ordinary/restart controls explicitly observe 22+ seconds; base allowed cases use shorter waits.

warningsAndBoundaries: The 1.20.1 base console retains Purpur SparkProviderSource download timeout; Minecraft still reached Done and all 26 guard assertions plus normal stop passed.

The 1.21.1 protocol client logs retain PartialReadError messages in third-party registry/component decoding. Every listed guard packet/command assertion passed; this is not a claim that all minecraft-protocol packets decode correctly.
Special catalog fixture logs retain No key layers in MapLike[{}]; no ore, terrain, flat-world, or Anti-Xray assertion depends on that generator.
Offline-mode, legacy api-version/material support, terminal/SIMD and disconnect warnings remain in unmodified logs. All player/device identities here are deterministic QA values.
The existing full helper enables command-gate tests and disables Anti-Xray tests; therefore each run has exactly 26 groups, not the 27-group integrated suite.
Historical 42 groups for Bukkit 0.1.1 SHA E119 are separate evidence and are not counted for this new artifact.
No game/client performance, real cheat execution, modified-client resilience, hardware identity trust, or all-version compatibility claim is inferred.

lifecycle.scope: All four owned server processes were waited to exit 0 by their drivers; each test listener port is released.
